cards.title: Loop until you get there
cards.body: When you do not know how many rounds you need, use `while` with the opposite of your goal: keep going while you are not there yet.
cards.code:
x = 1
while x < 100:
    x = x * 2
print(x)

hi.title: Wahan pahunchne tak loop
hi.body: Jab pata na ho kitne rounds chahiye, toh apne goal ke ulte ke saath `while` use karo: jab tak wahan nahi pahunche, chalte raho.

cards.title: The value after the loop
cards.body: When a `while` loop ends, its variable holds the first value that made the condition False.

hi.title: Loop ke baad ki value
hi.body: Jab `while` loop khatam hota hai, uske variable mein woh pehli value hoti hai jisne condition ko False banaya.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should keep doubling until it passes 1000 and print 1024, but it prints 1. Tap the bug.
cards.code:
x = 1
while x > 1000:
    x = x * 2
print(x)

bug.fix: `1 > 1000` is False straight away, so the loop never runs. Keep going while you are not there yet: `while x <= 1000:`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 1000 paar hone tak double karte rehna chahiye aur 1024 print karna chahiye, par yeh 1 print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `1 > 1000` shuru se hi False hai, isliye loop kabhi chalta hi nahi. Jab tak wahan nahi pahunche, chalte raho: `while x <= 1000:`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.code:
k = 1
while k * k < 20:
    k += 1
print(k)
check.explanation: 4 * 4 is 16, still under 20, so k grows to 5. Then 5 * 5 = 25 stops the loop.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 4 * 4 = 16, abhi bhi 20 se kam, isliye k 5 ho jaata hai. Phir 5 * 5 = 25 loop rok deta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a whole number N and print the smallest whole number k (starting from 1) whose square `k * k` is greater than N. Use a `while` loop.
exercise.promptHi: Ek whole number N padho aur woh sabse chhota whole number k print karo (1 se shuru) jiska square `k * k` N se bada ho. `while` loop use karo.
exercise.starterCode:
n = int(input())
k = 1
# grow k until k * k > n
print(k)
